support_policy: 2 train-only informative chunks bracketing train-estimated balance position; one-sided extreme environments use a balanced sample plus nearest nonbalanced sample

support_fallback.trigger: only one annotated tilt direction available among eligible training candidates
support_fallback.selection: minimum absolute support_fraction gap between a balanced and an explicitly left_down/right_down training sample

query_policy: 2 disjoint train episodes plus all 5 test episodes per environment
chunk_policy: midpoint of training-compatible Lift starts; drift episodes use stable Lift only
support_padding_loss: exclude initial condition and every partly or fully padded future VAE block
